dedupe_keys.name: campagne oceanographique in situ aux abords de saint malo shom

description: Shom publishes currents, waves and water levels measured around Saint-Malo during the winter 2018–2019 flood-prevention campaign. The provider records coverage from 13 November 2018 to 1 May 2019 and a network of 22 moorings with 37 instruments. Four processing levels range from raw binary or ASCII observations through manufacturer-processed outputs to NetCDF data and derived wave parameters. The Sextant landing page provides open access under a Creative Commons Attribution licence, with no version specified, and requests acknowledgement of the project partners. Reuse is free under those attribution conditions. A limitation is that this is one seasonal campaign, with differing instrument sampling and processing, not a continuous long-term coastal record. The observations can calibrate coupled wave and hydrodynamic simulations of overtopping at Saint-Malo defences. They complement the project’s 5 m and 20 m terrain models with measured boundary and validation information. No sensor files were downloaded.
